metadata.archetype_justification: The application manages persistent state (content items, users, settings) stored in SQL Server/SQL CE via NHibernate ORM. It exposes CRUD endpoints for content management with create, update, delete, and publish operations. Classified as stateful-crud.

decomposition_strategy.rationale: 62 identifiable modules with defined interfaces but shared NHibernate session and database schema. Strangler Fig enables incremental extraction.

findings.title: No managed compute — traditional IIS deployment
findings.description: No managed compute infrastructure found. The application is deployed via MSDeploy to traditional IIS on Windows Server. No ECS, EKS, Lambda, or Fargate resources defined.
findings.gap: All compute is on traditional IIS hosting with no managed container orchestration or serverless.
findings.recommendation: Containerize the application using Windows containers on ECS Fargate as a first step. Long-term, migrate to .NET 8+ to enable Linux containers and serverless options.

findings.title: Self-managed database — no RDS/Aurora
findings.description: The application uses SQL Server and SQL CE as database providers via NHibernate ORM. No managed database infrastructure is defined.
findings.gap: All databases are self-managed with no RDS/Aurora/managed service configuration.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for SQL Server (minimal code change) or Aurora PostgreSQL (leveraging NHibernate's PostgreSQL dialect).

findings.title: Internal messaging only — no managed cloud messaging
findings.description: Internal message bus and job queue modules exist but no managed messaging infrastructure (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, MSK) is configured.
findings.gap: Internal messaging exists but no managed cloud messaging for cross-service state changes or durable job processing.
findings.recommendation: When decomposing the monolith, introduce SQS for job queue durability and SNS/EventBridge for content lifecycle event publishing.

findings.title: No network security configuration
findings.description: No VPC, subnet, security group, or network segmentation configuration found in the repository.
findings.gap: No evidence of network security configuration.
findings.recommendation: Define VPC with public/private subnet tiers, least-privilege security groups, and deploy in private subnets behind an ALB.

findings.title: No managed API entry point
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, CloudFront, or AppSync configuration found. Service exposed directly via IIS.
findings.gap: No managed API entry point — service is exposed directly without gateway-level protections.
findings.recommendation: Deploy behind an ALB with health checks, or API Gateway for throttling and authentication offloading.

findings.title: No auto-scaling configured
findings.description: No auto-scaling configuration found. All capacity is statically provisioned.
findings.gap: No auto-scaling — all capacity is statically provisioned.
findings.recommendation: After containerizing, configure ECS service auto-scaling with target tracking policies.

findings.title: No backup or recovery configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. No AWS Backup plans, RDS backup retention, or S3 versioning.
findings.gap: No automated backup or recovery configuration.
findings.recommendation: After migrating to RDS, enable automated backups with PITR. Configure AWS Backup plans.

findings.title: No high availability configuration
findings.description: No multi-AZ configuration found. Single-instance deployment pattern via MSDeploy.
findings.gap: No high availability or fault isolation — single point of failure.
findings.recommendation: Deploy across multiple AZs with ALB cross-zone load balancing and Multi-AZ RDS.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC found — no Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or Helm. All infrastructure is manually provisioned.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage — all infrastructure is manually provisioned.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS CDK (C# supported) or Terraform to define all infrastructure.

findings.title: CI exists but no CD — deployment is manual
findings.description: GitHub Actions CI pipelines exist for compilation and testing. No deployment automation exists.
findings.gap: Build and test are automated but deployment is manual.
findings.recommendation: Extend the GitHub Actions pipeline to include deployment stages using CDK deploy or CodeDeploy.

findings.title: Legacy .NET Framework 4.8 with ASP.NET MVC 5
findings.description: C# 7.3 on .NET Framework 4.8 with ASP.NET MVC 5.3. Legacy platform requiring migration to .NET 8+.
findings.gap: .NET Framework 4.8, C# 7.3, and ASP.NET MVC 5 are all regressed. Requires migration to .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Core.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to .NET 8+ with ASP.NET Core for modern cloud-native support, Linux containers, and AWS SDK v3.

findings.title: Modular monolith with shared database
findings.description: Single deployable unit with 62 modules sharing a NHibernate session and database schema.
findings.gap: Monolith with identifiable modules but shared database schemas and ORM session.
findings.recommendation: Begin with enforcing module boundaries, then apply Strangler Fig to extract high-value modules.

findings.title: All communication synchronous in-process
findings.description: All inter-module communication is synchronous in-process method calls via Autofac DI and event bus.
findings.gap: Primarily synchronous with internal job queue. No managed async messaging.
findings.recommendation: Introduce EventBridge for content lifecycle events and SQS for durable background jobs when decomposing.

findings.title: Inconsistent long-running process handling
findings.description: Background task infrastructure and job queue exist but long-running operations (import/export, indexing) may block request threads.
findings.gap: Some background job infrastructure exists but inconsistent patterns.
findings.recommendation: Offload long-running operations to Step Functions or SQS-backed workers with status polling.

findings.title: No API versioning strategy
findings.description: No explicit API versioning. Web API routes do not include version prefixes.
findings.gap: No API versioning — breaking changes affect all consumers simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL-path versioning (e.g., /api/v1/) when modernizing the API layer.

findings.title: Configuration-based service resolution
findings.description: Internal services resolved via Autofac DI. External endpoints configured via Web.config, not hard-coded.
findings.gap: No dynamic service discovery for external services — configuration-based.
findings.recommendation: When decomposing, adopt AWS Cloud Map or ECS service connect.

findings.title: Media stored on local file system
findings.description: Unstructured data stored via FileSystemStorageProvider on local disk. No S3 or cloud storage.
findings.gap: Unstructured data on local file systems — not scalable, creates deployment coupling.
findings.recommendation: Migrate media storage to Amazon S3. Implement S3-backed IStorageProvider.

findings.title: Repository pattern exists but inconsistently applied
findings.description: IRepository<T> and NHibernate Repository exist in core but modules can bypass via direct session access.
findings.gap: Repository pattern exists but inconsistently applied across modules.
findings.recommendation: Enforce repository pattern consistently. Remove direct ISessionLocator usage from modules.

findings.title: No database engine version pinning
findings.description: No explicit database engine version pinning. SQL CE (bundled) is EOL. Production SQL Server version unknown.
findings.gap: No version pinning for production database. SQL CE (development) is EOL.
findings.recommendation: Pin database engine version in IaC when migrating to RDS. Verify current SQL Server is not EOL.

findings.title: Cookie-based forms authentication — not token-based
findings.description: Forms Authentication (cookie-based) rather than OAuth2/JWT. Optional OpenId module exists but is not default.
findings.gap: Cookie-based forms authentication rather than token-based auth.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to token-based authentication. Integrate with Amazon Cognito or enable OpenId module.

findings.title: Self-managed authentication — no centralized IdP
findings.description: Application manages its own authentication via FormsAuthenticationService and local user store.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication with local user store — no centralized IdP.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or enterprise IdP as primary authentication source.

findings.title: Credentials in config files — no secrets management
findings.description: Connection strings in Web.config with no Secrets Manager, Vault, or encrypted parameter store.
findings.gap: Credentials stored in configuration files with no secrets management, no encryption, no rotation.
findings.recommendation: Migrate all secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: No compute hardening or patching strategy
findings.description: No SSM Patch Manager, AWS Inspector, vulnerability scanning, or hardened images.
findings.gap: No patching strategy, no vulnerability scanning, no compute hardening.
findings.recommendation: After containerizing, use ECR image scanning and AWS Inspector. Use hardened AMIs if on EC2.

findings.title: Code analysis rulesets but no SAST/dependency scanning in CI
findings.description: Code analysis rulesets integrated into build. No Dependabot, no SAST tool, no container scanning.
findings.gap: Build-time code analysis exists but no dedicated SAST or dependency vulnerability scanning in CI/CD.
findings.recommendation: Add Dependabot for NuGet dependency scanning. Integrate SonarQube or Semgrep SAST.

findings.title: No distributed tracing
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, or tracing SDK. Glimpse is a dev-time profiler, not production tracing.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing — debugging production request flows is not possible.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry .NET instrumentation with X-Ray exporter.

findings.title: No business metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Only log4net operational logging.
findings.gap: No business outcome metrics — cannot measure content engagement or user activity.
findings.recommendation: Instrument key business metrics and publish to CloudWatch custom metrics.

findings.title: No alerting or anomaly detection
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration, no monitoring.
findings.gap: No alerting configured — failures go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Enable anomaly detection.

findings.title: BDD tests exist but no integration tests against deployed services
findings.description: SpecFlow BDD tests and unit tests run in CI but test in-process, not against deployed infrastructure.
findings.gap: No integration tests against deployed services, no contract tests.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests with real SQL Server (TestContainers). Add contract tests when decomposing.

findings.title: No incident response automation
findings.description: No runbooks, SSM Automation documents, or self-healing patterns.
findings.gap: No runbooks — incident response is entirely ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common incidents. Implement as SSM Automation documents.

findings.title: No observability ownership
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS for monitoring, no per-service dashboards, no named alarm owners.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Define observability ownership with CODEOWNERS and per-module dashboards.

findings.title: No resource tagging
findings.description: No IaC exists to tag resources. No tagging standard or enforcement.
findings.gap: No tags found on resources.
findings.recommendation: Establish tagging standard and enforce via IaC when implementing infrastructure.

evaluations.title: Workflow Orchestration
evaluations.reason: stateful-crud archetype — Orchard.Workflows module provides content lifecycle workflows but dedicated infrastructure orchestration (Step Functions, Temporal) is not expected for CRUD operations.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: has_iac_provisioning_aws_resources=false — CloudTrail is an account-level concern. This application repo does not provision AWS resources.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: has_iac_provisioning_aws_resources=false — encryption at rest is configured on infrastructure side which is absent from this repo.

evaluations.title: SLO Definitions
evaluations.reason: has_deployed_workload=false — SLOs cannot be assessed from source code alone without deployment infrastructure.

evaluations.title: Deployment Strategy
evaluations.reason: has_deployed_workload=false — no deployed workload defined in this repo. Deployment orchestration may exist in a separate repo.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — no stored procedures, triggers, or proprietary SQL. All business logic in C# application layer via NHibernate ORM.

pathways.name: Move to Open Source
